name: Steel guard tower
description: Modern steel guard tower: four square-tube legs with cross bracing carrying a 2.7 m chequer-plate platform 3.2 m up, enclosed by a steel kick wall and sandbags to chest height with a corrugated roof on posts; a steel stair with handrails climbs from the rear, and a caged ladder runs up one leg to a roof hatch. The platform is walkable.
